name: @smarthire/marketing
description: The marketing site. Everything a visitor sees before they have an account: the pitch, how it works, features, pricing and the comparison. No auth, no database, no payment keys.
_comment_port: 3002, forced, and NOT 3000 or 3001. Not 3000: apps/dashboard's dev script takes it, and apps/desktop/.env points WEB_URL at http://127.0.0.1:3000 — the IP rather than localhost, because Electron's main process runs Node and resolves localhost to ::1 without falling back. If this app could win the race for 3000 the desktop would silently talk to the marketing site and every licence check would 404. NOT 3001, which was the original choice and was wrong: another long-running project on this machine holds 3001, and the two do NOT cleanly collide — that one binds IPv4 and Next binds :: for IPv6, so both start successfully and you reach a different app depending on whether you typed localhost or 127.0.0.1. A hard EADDRINUSE would have been kinder than that.
_comment_no_turbo: No --turbo flag, unlike apps/dashboard. Turbopack is the default bundler in Next 16; that flag is a v15 leftover over there and is not worth propagating.
_comment_deps: THREE DELIBERATE ABSENCES, compared with apps/dashboard. (1) No @supabase/* — this deployment asks nobody whether they are signed in, so it holds no Supabase keys at all and the whole class of cookie-scoping problems is unreachable rather than merely avoided. (2) No autoprefixer — apps/dashboard lists it but its postcss config never loads it, and Tailwind v4 runs Lightning CSS internally; a dead dependency is not worth carrying forward. (3) No stripe — this site never starts a checkout; it links to the app, which does.
